# **Здания, которые план ставит именно здесь.** `_plan_builds` -- список типов на
# самой локации, его ведут и раздача, и редактор, так что фишка показывает то,
# что на карте сейчас: загрузили слот -- показывает слот.
#
# **`root` в фильтре -- не отфильтровываемый объект, что бы ни говорил
# `58_building_type.txt`.** Прогон 2026-09-09: фишка на `target = root` не
# оставила ни одного здания при `view_location=1` и `_plan_builds`, заполненном
# на 454 локациях; единственная другая фишка в репозитории, читавшая `root`
# (`bag_rgo_has_local_bonus`), -- ровно та, что никогда не работала, а все
# работающие спрашивают неявный `this`. Комментарий игры врёт про `root` так же,
# как он уже соврал про `scope:target`; в `06_country.txt` она сама пишет «root
# is player».
#
# Отсюда форма: **`this = building_type:X` до смены скоупа**, а внутрь идёт
# литерал. Ни одного `root`.
# Scope: building_type
bag_wtp_type_in_plan_here = {
	has_global_variable = bag_view_location
	OR = {
		AND = {
			this = building_type:ablaq_palace
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:ablaq_palace }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:apothecary
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:apothecary }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:beer_workshop
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:beer_workshop }
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:brewery_manufactory }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_brewery_manufactory = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:brewery_mill }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_brewery_manufactory = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_brewery_mill = 1 }
				}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:bog_iron_smelter
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:bog_iron_smelter }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:brewery
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:brewery }
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:beer_workshop }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_beer_workshop = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:brewery_manufactory }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_beer_workshop = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_brewery_manufactory = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:brewery_mill }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_beer_workshop = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_brewery_manufactory = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_brewery_mill = 1 }
				}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:brewery_manufactory
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:brewery_manufactory }
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:brewery_mill }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_brewery_mill = 1 }
				}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:brewery_mill
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:brewery_mill }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:cannon_foundry
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:cannon_foundry }
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:cannons_factory }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_cannons_factory = 1 }
				}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:cannon_maker
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:cannon_maker }
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:cannon_workshop }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_cannon_workshop = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:cannon_foundry }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_cannon_workshop = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_cannon_foundry = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:cannons_factory }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_cannon_workshop = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_cannon_foundry = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_cannons_factory = 1 }
				}
				}

			this = building_type:tools_guild
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:tools_guild }
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:tools_workshop }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_tools_workshop = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:iron_foundry }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_tools_workshop = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_iron_foundry = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:iron_mill }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_tools_workshop = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_iron_foundry = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_iron_mill = 1 }
				}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:tools_workshop
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:tools_workshop }
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:iron_foundry }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_iron_foundry = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:iron_mill }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_iron_foundry = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_iron_mill = 1 }
				}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:weapon_factory
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:weapon_factory }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:weapon_guild
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:weapon_guild }
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:weapon_workshop }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_weapon_workshop = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:weapon_manufactory }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_weapon_workshop = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_weapon_manufactory = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:weapon_factory }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_weapon_workshop = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_weapon_manufactory = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_weapon_factory = 1 }
				}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:weapon_manufactory
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:weapon_manufactory }
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:weapon_factory }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_weapon_factory = 1 }
				}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:weapon_workshop
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:weapon_workshop }
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:weapon_manufactory }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_weapon_manufactory = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:weapon_factory }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_weapon_manufactory = 1 }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_weapon_factory = 1 }
				}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:winery
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:winery }
				AND = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:winery_manufactory }
					NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_ba_winery_manufactory = 1 }
				}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			this = building_type:winery_manufactory
			global_var:bag_view_location = {
				OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:winery_manufactory }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
